menu.mellowui.out_of_memory.message:
This could be caused by a bug in the game or by the Java Virtual Machine not being allocated enough memory.

To prevent world corruption, the current game has quit. We've tried to free up enough memory to let you go back to the main menu and back to playing, but this may not have worked.

Please restart the game if you see this message again.

panorama.mellowui.default.desc: The default Minecraft panorama. This one can be changed via resource packs.
panorama.mellowui.beta.desc: The panorama added in Beta 1.8, and used until its replacement in 1.13.
panorama.mellowui.generated.desc: A panorama added by another mod that substituted the default panorama.
config.mellowui.main_menu_mod_button.too:
Where the 'Mods' button should be located in the main menu.
%s
config.mellowui.main_menu_mod_button.opt: §lAdjacent§r: Places the mods button besides Realms as a button with text.
§lIcon§r: Places the mods button besides Realms as an icon button, like accessibility.
§lReplace Realms§r: Replaces Realms with the mods button, as Realms doesn't work with Forge or in older versions.
§lBelow Realms§r: Places the mods button below Realms, like in NeoForge.
config.mellowui.pause_menu_mod_button.to:
Where the 'Mods' button should be located in the pause menu.
%s
config.mellowui.pause_menu_mod_button.op: §lAdjacent§r: Moves the feedback buttons into a 'Feedback...' subscreen, and adds the mods button besides it.
§lIcon§r: Places the mods button besides 'Report Bugs' as an icon button.
§lReplace§r: Replaces the 'Give Feedback' and 'Report Bugs' buttons in the pause menu.
§lBelow Options§r: Places the mods button below the 'Options' and 'Open to LAN'.
config.mellowui.legacy_button_colors.too: Makes the text in widgets slightly darker, and when hovered the text will have a slight yellow tint.
config.mellowui.panorama_bobbing.tooltip: Whether the panorama should bob up and down instead of being at a consistent pitch.
config.mellowui.panorama_camera_pitch.to: The pitch of the panoramic camera. Defaults to 10º.
config.mellowui.list_background_style.to: Updates the background of all lists (like video settings or languages) for a transparent background, like the new UI introduced in 1.20.5.
config.mellowui.logo_style.tooltip: Style to use for the Minecraft logo. Includes the pre-1.16 logo, the current logo (1.16), the new logo (1.20+), and the Mellomedley logo.
config.mellowui.title_style.tooltip:
The style to use for the main menu.
§eIt is recommended to turn this off if you're using FancyMenu or Better Title Screen, as most modpacks update the main menu using these mods.
config.mellowui.pause_style.tooltip:
The style to use for the pause menu.
Centralizes all buttons and adds the 'Mods' button.
config.mellowui.create_new_world_style.t:
The style to use for the create new world menu.
Backports the updated menu from 1.19.4 with more functionality included.
config.mellowui.options_style.tooltip:
The style to use for the options menu.
Adds new buttons and moves the 'Done' button down.
config.mellowui.skin_customization_style:
The style to use for the skin customization menu.
Replaces the buttons with a list, like in other screens.
config.mellowui.music_and_sounds_style.t:
The style to use for the music and sounds menu.
Replaces the buttons with a list and adds options from newer versions.
config.mellowui.video_settings_style.too:
The style to use for the video settings menu.
Makes the title height consistent, reorganizes the button layouts, and changes some options.
config.mellowui.controls_style.tooltip:
The style to use for the controls menu.
Makes it a subcategory of a new screen, which includes various other options.
config.mellowui.mouse_settings_style.too:
The style to use for the mouse settings menu.
Makes the title height consistent, reorganizes the button layouts, and changes some options.
config.mellowui.chat_settings_style.tool:
The style to use for the chat settings menu.
Makes the title height consistent, reorganizes the button layouts, and changes some options.
config.mellowui.pack_list_style.tooltip:
The style to use for the resource and data pack menus.
Completely overhauls the menu by unifying the lists and updating the pack selection.
config.mellowui.accessibility_settings_s:
The style to use for the accessibility settings menu.
Makes the title height consistent and reorganizes the button layouts.
config.mellowui.out_of_memory_style.tool:
The style to use for the out of memory menu.
Makes the screen resemble Windows' BSOD.
config.mellowui.statistics_style.tooltip:
The style to use for the statistics menu.
Backports the updated version of it from 1.21.9, adding tabs and making the entries selectable.
config.mellowui.mod_list_style.tooltip:
The style to use for Forge's mod list menu.
Mellow UI's completely overhauls it, separating it in three parts with the list, the information and the buttons.
config.mellowui.replace_realms_notificat: Replaces the 'Realms Notifications' button in the options screen with the online options button from newer versions.
config.mellowui.splash_text_position.too: Where the splash texts should be positioned in the main menu.
config.mellowui.disable_branding.tooltip: Disables Forge's branding lines. Branding lines are the Forge and MCP versions in the bottom-left corner.
config.mellowui.scrolling_text.tooltip: Makes the text in widgets scroll if it's too long instead of rendering on top of other widgets.
config.mellowui.classified_as_containers:
List of classes for screens that don't blur the background and instead render a transparent gradient.
§o§lClick to configure.
config.mellowui.oversized_in_gui.tooltip:
List of items that are allowed to render past their slot boundary.
§o§lClick to configure.
config.mellowui.cull_oversized_items.too: Whether items that render past their slot should be culled to fit.
config.mellowui.background_shaders.toolt:
Whether shaders, like super secret settings and the blur, should render on the panorama.
§aThis may fix rendering issues in menus added by other mods.
config.mellowui.blurry_containers.toolti: If the background blur and shaders should be applied on containers like chests, furnaces and your inventory.
config.mellowui.default_background.toolt: Whether to use the default dirt background texture instead of the current, transparent background.
config.mellowui.gradient_background.tool: Makes in-game screens use a gray gradient background instead of a regular transparent background.
config.mellowui.log_gl_errors.tooltip:
Whether to log OpenGL error messages, in order to not spam the logs.
§aUseful if playing with §oFabulous!§r§a graphics.
config.mellowui.default_widget_text_colo: The color used for active widgets.
config.mellowui.highlighted_widget_text_: The color used for active widgets that are hovered or focused.
config.mellowui.disabled_widget_text_col: The color used for inactive widgets.
config.mellowui.default_legacy_widget_te: The color used for active widgets while the 'Legacy Button Colors' option is on.
config.mellowui.highlighted_legacy_widge: The color used for active widgets that are hovered or focused while the 'Legacy Button Colors' option is on.
config.mellowui.disabled_legacy_widget_t: The color used for inactive widgets while the 'Legacy Button Colors' option is on.
config.mellowui.highlighted_icon_button_: The color used for main menu icon buttons that are hovered or focused.
The color used for the center of a text field.
config.mellowui.text_field_default_borde: The color used for the border of unselected text fields.
config.mellowui.text_field_highlighted_b: The color used for the border of text fields that are hovered or focused.
config.mellowui.text_field_suggestion_co: The color used for the suggestion of unselected text fields.
config.mellowui.text_field_highlighted_s: The color used for the suggestion of text fields that are hovered of focused.
config.mellowui.text_field_highlight_col: The color used when highlighting text on text fields.
config.mellowui.splash_text_color.toolti: Determines which color is used for the splash text.
config.mellowui.high_contrast_splash_tex: Determines which color is used for the splash text when the 'High Contrast' resource pack is enabled.
config.mellowui.default_update_available: Determines which color is used for the "Update Available!" button on Mellow UI's mod list screen.
config.mellowui.high_contrast_update_ava: Determines which color is used for the "Update Available!" button on Mellow UI's mod list screen when the 'High Contrast' resource pack is enabled.
config.mellowui.monochrome_loading_scree: Changes the color of the loading screen to this color when the 'Monochrome Loading Screen' option is enabled.
config.mellowui.description_text_color.t: The color used for descriptions in Mellow UI.
config.mellowui.button_text_padding.tool:
The padding amount, in Minecraft pixels (mpx), for the text in a button.
Effectively capped at 'buttonWidth / 2 - 1'.
config.mellowui.edit_button_text_padding:
The padding amount, in Minecraft pixels (mpx), for the text in an edit button.
Effectively capped at 'buttonWidth / 2 - 1'.
config.mellowui.tab_text_padding.tooltip:
The padding amount, in Minecraft pixels (mpx), for the text in a tab.
Effectively capped at 'tabWidth / 2 - 1'.
config.mellowui.mod_name_text_padding.to:
The padding amount, in Minecraft pixels (mpx), for the text in a mod entry.
Effectively capped at 'entryWidth / 2 - 1'.
config.mellomedley.mellomedley_version.t: The current version of the Mellomedley modpack, displayed on its variant of the main menu.
config.mellomedley.splash_text_color.too: Determines which color is used for the splash text on Mellomedley's main menu.
Where the 'Mods' button should be located on Mellomedley's main menu.
%s
§lIcon§r: Places the 'Mods' button as an icon button between accessibility and language in the footer.
§lBelow Options§r: Places the 'Mods' button below the 'Options' button, moving all other buttons down.
config.minecraft.realms_notifications.to: Fetches Realms news and invites in the title screen and displays their respective icon on the Realms button.
config.minecraft.closed_captions.tooltip: Enables captions for sounds played in the game.
config.minecraft.monochrome_loading_scre: Changes the Mojang Studios loading screen background color to, by default, black.
config.minecraft.panorama_scroll_speed.t: Changes the scrolling speed of the panoramic background.
config.minecraft.menu_background_blurrin: Changes the blurriness of menu backgrounds.
config.minecraft.hide_splash_texts.toolt: Hides the yellow splash text in the main menu.
config.minecraft.show_music_toast.toolti: Displays a toast whenever a song starts playing. The same toast is constantly displayed in the in-game pause menu while a song is playing.
config.minecraft.high_contrast.tooltip: Enhances the contrast of UI elements.
config.minecraft.high_contrast.not_avail: High Contrast resource pack is not available.
config.minecraft.directional_audio.on_to: Uses HRTF-based directional audio to improve the simulation of 3D sound. Requires HRTF compatible audio hardware, and is best experienced with headphones.
config.minecraft.sound_device.tooltip: Which device Minecraft should output audio from.
config.minecraft.sound_category.ui.toolt: The volume of the in-game UI elements.
config.minecraft.onboard_accessibility.t: Whether to show the accessibility onboarding menu upon loading the game for the first time.
config.minecraft.difficulty.peaceful.too: No hostile mobs and only some neutral mobs spawn. Hunger bar doesn't deplete and health replenishes over time.
config.minecraft.difficulty.easy.tooltip: Hostile mobs spawn but deal less damage. Hunger bar depletes and drains health down to 5 hearts.
config.minecraft.difficulty.normal.toolt: Hostile mobs spawn and deal standard damage. Hunger bar depletes and drains health down to half a heart.
config.minecraft.difficulty.hard.tooltip: Hostile mobs spawn and deal more damage. Hunger bar depletes and drains all health.
config.minecraft.difficulty.hardcore.too:
§c§lHardcore:§r
You can't respawn if you die. Good luck! You'll need it.
config.forge.server_settings.only_in_wor: Server settings can only be configured while in a world!
config.forge.remove_erroring_entities.to:
Removes any entities that throw an error in their update() method instead of closing the server and reporting a crash log.
§c§lWARNING§r§c: Use sparingly, as this can screw up everything. WE ARE NOT RESPONSIBLE FOR DAMAGES!
config.forge.remove_erroring_block_entit:
Removes any block entities that throw an error in their update() method instead of closing the server and reporting a crash log.
§c§lWARNING§r§c: Use sparingly, as this can screw up everything. WE ARE NOT RESPONSIBLE FOR DAMAGES!
config.forge.full_bounding_box_ladders.t:
Makes entities check their whole bounding box for ladders instead of only the block they're in.
Causes noticeable differences in mechanics.
config.forge.fix_advancement_loading.too: Fixes advancement loading to use a proper topological sort. This may have visibility side effects and can be turned off if needed for data pack compatibility.
config.forge.base_zombie_summon_chance.t: Base zombie summoning spawn chance. Allows changing the bonus zombie summoning mechanic.
config.forge.baby_zombie_chance.tooltip: Chance that a zombie (or subtype) is a baby. Allows changing the zombie spawning mechanic.
config.forge.log_cascading_world_generat: Log cascading chunk generation issues during terrain population.
config.forge.fix_vanilla_cascading.toolt:
Fix vanilla issues that cause world generation cascading.
§c§lWARNING§r§c: This changes vanilla world generation, so don't report world generation related issues if this setting is on.
config.forge.dimension_unload_queue_dela: The time in ticks the server will wait when a dimension was queued to unload. This can be useful when rapidly loading and unloading dimensions, like throwing items through a Nether portal a few times per second.
config.forge.treat_empty_tags_as_air.too:
Vanilla treats crafting recipes using empty tags as air, and allows you to craft with nothing in that slot.
This changes empty tags to use barriers as the item to prevent crafting with air.
config.forge.mod_list_sorting.tooltip: How the mod list should be sorted.
config.forge.zoom_missing_text_in_guis: Zoom In Missing Model Text in GUIs
config.forge.zoom_missing_text_in_guis.t: Turn off to make missing model text in GUIs fit inside the slot.
config.forge.gpu_cloud_rendering.tooltip: Upload cloud geometry to the GPU for faster cloud rendering.
Disables culling hidden faces next to stairs and slabs. Causes extra rendering, but may fix some resource packs that exploit this vanilla mechanic.
config.forge.threaded_chunk_rendering.to:
Enables Forge to queue all chunk updates to the 'Chunk Update' thread.
May increase FPS significantly, but may also cause weird rendering lag.
§cNot recommended for computers without a significant number of cores available.
config.forge.forge_light_pipeline.toolti: Enables Forge's block rendering pipeline, which fixes the lighting of custom models.
config.forge.experimental_light_pipeline: Enables an experimental version of Forge's block rendering pipeline, which fixes the lighting of custom models.
Makes specific reload tasks such as changing languages quicker to run.
config.forge.use_combined_depth_stencil_: Use a combined depth stencil attachment instead of two separate ones.
config.forge.show_load_warnings.tooltip: Shows any warnings that occurred during loading.
post_effect.locked:
§c§lWARNING§r§c:
The current panorama prohibits changing the shaders.
post_effect.mellowui.blur.tooltip: Copy of §lBlur§7, but only applies to the panorama.
post_effect.minecraft.antialias.tooltip:
Blurs the edges of pixels to reduce jaggedness.
This is blurrier than §lFXAA§7, but is better at eliminating jagged edges in textures and blocks.
post_effect.minecraft.art.tooltip: Pixels are blurred outward, causing moving objects to twinkle.
post_effect.minecraft.bits.tooltip: Lowers the resolution and uses an 8-bit color scheme.
post_effect.minecraft.blobs.tooltip: Similar to §lBlobs2§7 and §lArt§7, but the spots are tiny when close up and big when far away.
post_effect.minecraft.blobs2.tooltip: Similar to §lArt§7, but less graphically intensive.
post_effect.minecraft.blur.tooltip: Blurs the screen overall, independent of what is being displayed.
post_effect.minecraft.bumpy.tooltip: Outlines color differences, and gives textures a 3D look.
post_effect.minecraft.creeper.tooltip:
Similar to §lGreen§7, but with no black borders and with a higher but still reduced resolution.
§dUsed when viewing the world as a creeper in Spectator mode.
post_effect.minecraft.deconverge.tooltip: Offsets the red, green, and blue color channels.
post_effect.minecraft.desaturate.tooltip: Reduces intensity of colors drastically, causing, as the name suggests, a desaturated effect.
post_effect.minecraft.entity_outline.too: Applies a blur over a solid color silhouette of an entity. Used when an entity with the glowing effect is on-screen.
post_effect.minecraft.fxaa.tooltip:
This shader adds a small amount of anti-aliasing (smoothing jagged edges), most visible in trees along the horizon.
Stands for 'Fast Approximate Anti-Aliasing'.
post_effect.minecraft.green.tooltip: §lScan Pincushion§7 and §lBits§7, but with a green overlay.
post_effect.minecraft.invert.tooltip:
Inverts and slightly desaturates colors.
§dUsed when viewing the world as an enderman in Spectator mode.
post_effect.mellowui.love.tooltip:
Applies a pink-ish overlay on top of the player's view/panorama.
Copied from snapshot 15w14a, the Love and Hugs April fools update.
post_effect.minecraft.notch.tooltip: Uses 8-bit color with half the resolution, with a dithering effect. This is a reference to how many of Notch's other games use a similar overlay.
post_effect.minecraft.ntsc.tooltip:
Gives the player's view/panorama the impression of a CRT Monitor/Television Screen.
Stands for 'National Television System Committee'.
post_effect.minecraft.outline.tooltip:
Outlines color differences similarly to §lBumpy§7, but less complex.
§eHas no effect on some computers.
post_effect.minecraft.pencil.tooltip: Meant to give the world a pencil-sketch appearance.
post_effect.minecraft.phosphor.tooltip: Pixels on screen linger, being "dragged out" when in motion before fading away.
post_effect.minecraft.scan_pincushion.to: Similar to §lNTSC§7, but without the blurring and much less graphically intensive.
post_effect.minecraft.sobel.tooltip: Turns the view black except for the edges of textures.
post_effect.minecraft.spider.tooltip:
Eight 'eyes' onscreen with blur in between, similar to a spider's face.
§dUsed when viewing the world as a spider or cave spider in Spectator mode.
post_effect.minecraft.wobble.tooltip: Colors cycle through the hue range constantly.
